entry.name: jit.resamp
entry.description: jit.resamp spatially resamples the input matrix. This can be used to scale (zoom in/out) and offset (move) an image horizontally, vertically, or in both directions.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.digest: Value wrap flag
attributes.description: Value wrap flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, values that exceed the limits are wrapped around to the opposite limit with a modulo operation. (1.1 wraps to .1, 1.2 wraps to .2, and -1.1 wraps to .9, -1.2 wraps to .8, etc.)

attributes.name: xscale
attributes.digest: Horizontal scaling factor
attributes.description: The scaling factor for the x (horizontal) dimension (default = 1.)

attributes.name: xshift
attributes.digest: Horizontal offset
attributes.description: The shift (offset) amount for x (horizontal) dimension values (default = 0.). Positive values shift right, negative values shift left.

attributes.name: yscale
attributes.digest: Vertical scaling factor
attributes.description: The scaling factor for the y (vertical) dimension (default = 1.)

attributes.name: yshift
attributes.digest: Vertical offset
attributes.description: The shift (offset) amount for the y (vertical) dimension values (default = 0.) Positive values shift down, negative values shift up.
